SELECT g.*, CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END as checked FROM goal g LEFT JOIN checkin c ON g.id = c.goal_id AND c.date = #{today} WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} AND g.status = 'active' ORDER BY g.create_time DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE goal SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
